Analyze this incident/failure: <incident>

Prioritize containment, evidence integrity, user impact, and recovery. Do not expose secrets or private data.

Build a timeline from known facts, then identify:
- impact and affected scope;
- detection method and gaps;
- trigger and root cause;
- contributing factors;
- containment/recovery actions;
- data/security/privacy implications;
- tests/monitoring/guardrails that would have detected or prevented recurrence.

Separate immediate remediation from longer-term prevention. Avoid blame-oriented language.
